title: Combination Sum: Filling a 12-Litre Tank with Jugs
summary: Add jugs while they fit, record exact fills, undo, and prune any jug bigger than what's left.

analogy.scenario: A 12-litre tank must be filled exactly using 4-litre and 6-litre jugs, as many of each as needed. Which mixes of jugs fill it exactly (order doesn't matter)?

mapping.real: A jug too big for what's left

takeaway.summary: Sort the candidates; from each node try candidates from the last one used onward. Stop the loop at the first candidate bigger than what's left: everything after it is bigger too.
takeaway.timeComplexity: Exponential in target / smallest candidate, cut down by pruning
takeaway.spaceComplexity: O(target / smallest candidate) for the path
whenToUse: Combinations that hit a target sum
Searches where a bound rules out whole branches

scenes.narration: A 12-litre tank must be filled exactly with 4-litre and 6-litre jugs, as many of each as needed. Which mixes of jugs work?
scenes.caption: Fill 12 litres exactly with 4 L and 6 L jugs

scenes.narration: Pour one jug at a time and track the litres left. To avoid counting the same mix twice, only pour jugs at least as big as the last one.
scenes.caption: Pour jug by jug: a tree of choices, nodes show litres left

scenes.narration: Start with a 4-litre jug: 12 minus 4 leaves 8.
scenes.caption: Pour a 4 L jug: 8 litres left

scenes.narration: Two more 4-litre jugs bring it to 0 left: an exact fill. Record 4, 4, 4.
scenes.caption: Two more 4s: exactly full. Record 4, 4, 4

scenes.narration: Step back: pour the last 4 back out, leaving 4 litres to fill, and try the next jug size.
scenes.caption: Pour the last 4 back out: 4 litres left again

scenes.narration: A 6-litre jug is more than the 4 left, and nothing after it is smaller. That whole branch is cut without trying it.
scenes.caption: A 6 L jug won't fit in 4: cut the branch

scenes.narration: Back at the start, pour a 6-litre jug, then another: 0 left. Record 6, 6.
scenes.caption: Starting with a 6 L jug: 6 + 6 fills it

scenes.narration: Every branch is finished or cut. Two mixes fill the tank exactly: three 4s, or two 6s.
scenes.caption: Two exact fills: 4 + 4 + 4 and 6 + 6

scenes.narration: Jugs are candidates and litres left is the remaining target. Sorting lets one too-big jug prune every bigger one: backtracking with pruning.
scenes.caption: Jugs are candidates; litres left is the target
